In [an earlier post](../ocaml-and-math/) the monoid laws showed up as an OCaml
`fold`. Here they are again as **theorems in Lean 4** — and this time the proofs
are interactive.

Each proof below is rendered with [Alectryon](https://github.com/cpitclaudel/alectryon)
driven by [LeanInk](https://github.com/leanprover/LeanInk). **Hover over a tactic**
(or the goal markers in the gutter) to see the proof state at that point: the
hypotheses in context and the goal that remains.

::: {.alectryon-center}
{{< include _Monoid.html >}}
:::

The associativity proof goes by induction on `c`: the `zero` case closes by
`rfl`, and the `succ` case rewrites with the inductive hypothesis. Step through
it above to watch the goal shrink.
